We have a synthetic demonstration project in:
{ROOT}

The repository variants live in:
{ROOT}\repository variants

The following folders are read-only:

{ROOT}\repository variants\archive
This contains historical snapshots. Nothing here may be changed.

{ROOT}\repository variants\vendor baseline
We may never change anything here. This is the untouched baseline supplied by
a fictional vendor.

{ROOT}\repository variants\upstream snapshot
This is a read-only copy of the current upstream source.

{ROOT}\repository variants\qa workspace
Here we may create test-only changes. Changes are limited to tests,
test support files, and TEST-ci.yml. Existing product and vendor workflow files
must remain untouched.

The tests must follow ordinary QA automation practices and the Arrange, Act,
Assert pattern. Comments should use plain language. Tests belong under
tests/UNIT, tests/API, and tests/E2E. Unit and API folders should mirror the
source layout.

API tests are named API-TEST-[interface]-[stable numeric id].
E2E tests are named E2E-[flow]-[stable numeric id].
Editing a test does not give it a new identity.

{ROOT}\repository variants\release bundle
After each change, create a dated-and-hourly folder containing only changed
files, preserving their repository paths, plus a plain-language
commit-message.md.

Create an HTML traceability workbook after every session in:
{ROOT}\test traceability

It must link each test to its plan and implementation state, explain what the
test does and why it exists, and identify its level and source file. Keep each
session in a dated-and-hourly subfolder so the record can be followed year
after year.

The following two folders are reference material only and must never become
write destinations:
C:\ReferenceFixtures\traceability\sample
Use this as a reference only.
C:\ReferenceFixtures\dashboard\sample
Use this as a reference only.

The LangGraph files must all live in:
{ROOT}\LangGraph policy

Keep durable project notes under:
{ROOT}\project memory

Record every session and its verified conclusions there so later work can
recover the reasoning.

The synthetic staging site is:
http://127.0.0.1:8999
